name: MenuBindingDevice
meaning: Device class byte returned in out[0] by the binding query 0x528026 and switched on by Menu_DrawBindingText.

name: BINDDEV_KEYBOARD
meaning: keyboard; the code is a DirectInput scancode resolved through Input_GetKeyName and drawn in yellow (0xFFFF50). Also the only class accepted by the keyboard-only rebinding path 0x527ECD.

name: BINDDEV_JOYSTICK
meaning: joystick; drawn as "JOY %d" in green (0x50FF50) and exempted from the allowed-key filter in Menu_RebindControl
